messages:
maya: Quick sync — post-launch triage for ChatFlow. We need alignment on bugs vs enhancements, hotfix criteria, and who owns fast turnarounds. Proposal: weekly grooming + daily critical triage. Thoughts?

sam: +1. Helpful if we define severity buckets concretely (P0/P1/P2) and map to actions.

li: There's already a customer report that looks like a model regression — customer A said ~10% of prompts returned hallucinations after deploy. Could be quality regression, may need urgent rollback/fallback.

ana: @maya FYI I'll paste the customer notes in the ticket, short repro + example prompts.

frank: Also seeing a pile of small UX polish asks. Those should be enhancements unless they block task flows.

maya: Drafting a quick decision rubric: 
- P0: outage, data loss, or system error preventing feature use => immediate hotfix/rollback.
- P1: major quality regression (>=10% key-metric drop or 1+ paying customer blocked) => hotfix lane.
- P2: moderate bugs or functionality gaps => next sprint priority.
- Enhancements (UX, polish, nice-to-have) => backlog grooming and milestone scheduling.

sam: For rollbacks vs patches: prefer fallback to previous model variant when possible, then patch or retrain. Rollback if rollback cost < debugging time and customer impact high.

li: Agreed. Quick policy snippet for the routing playbook:
```
if error_rate > 0.10 or impacted_customers >= 1:
  route_all_requests_to(stable_model_variant)
  create_ticket(labels=[hotfix, postlaunch], urgency=P1)
  notify(#oncall, @sam, @li)
```

maya: Nice. Ownership: volunteer check — @sam you own infra/rollout, @li you own model triage/fix, I'll own product comms + priority decisions, @ana gather repro and telemetry.

sam: I can own infra and rollout. I'll prepare a runbook step for fallback.

li: I'll take model triage. Will start with minimal prompt set repro and a bisect against model variants.

ana: Will add repro, request logs, and a short customer-facing note template in the ticket.

frank: For acceptance criteria on patches: no UI regressions, latency increase <= 100ms p50, and no new top-level errors in logs.

maya: Good constraints. For backlog grooming: 30-min weekly session (Tue 10:30) + keep an async backlog label 'postlaunch'. Add urgency tags P0/P1/P2. Also recommend reserving one engineer as a dedicated post-launch responder for the first 2 weeks.

li: Recommend rotation from eng-platform: 1-week shifts for the first month.

sam: eng-platform can support rotation. I'll add the rotation schedule to the runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy: ChatFlow v1.3 deployed at 2025-09-09T15:22:10Z

maya: Noted. I'll draft the post-launch runbook PR today and tag owners. Thanks everyone.

sam: Thanks — will start the fallback playbook draft now.

li: I'll update the eval harness to run the minimal prompt set nightly until we stabilize.

ana: Ticket created: https://tracker.internal/RED-2345 — added repro and customer notes.

maya: Perfect. We'll review in the grooming meeting tomorrow and lock hotfix criteria in the runbook.

frank: Quick ask — if a customer requests feature tweak during hotfix window, treat as enhancement unless it meets P1/P0.

maya: Agreed. Keep enhancement requests in backlog unless they block customers.

sam: Ending thread — I'll post the fallback steps as a short checklist in the runbook PR.

maya: Closing loop: PR coming from me to product-runbook, cc: eng-platform, eng-ml, support.
